editorial:
Imagine being a tough Chicago cop who doesn't take any nonsense, only to get killed and wake up as a gassy English bulldog. That is the wild ride you get here. You follow a gruff detective who still has his badge and his mean streak, but now he has to deal with paws and a very loud stomach. It is a goofy, high-energy fantasy comedy that doesn't take itself too seriously. You will spend most of the movie laughing at the struggle of a hard-boiled cop trying to solve a murder while everyone around him just sees a cute, smelly dog.

The acting is great because it plays up the absurdity of the situation, and the pacing keeps you moving quickly toward the big reveal. While the special effects are a bit dated, they actually add to the charm of this 90s gem. If you love silly premises and animal leads, you should definitely give this a shot. Since it is an older title, you might have to dig around to find it, but it is worth adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection for a movie night. If you prefer digital, try renting it on Apple TV to see the chaos unfold in high quality.
endingExplained: In the final act, the bulldog cop uses his instincts and dog skills to lead the real police right to the villain who killed him. After a messy showdown involving plenty of dog chaos, the killer is finally arrested. Once justice is served and the case is closed, the magic wears off. He is allowed to leave his dog body behind and move on to the afterlife, knowing he finished the job and cleared his name.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird 90s comedies and talking animals.
